subject: Launch of Gotta Know Medford Digital News
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed the founders of the new digital news outlet Gotta Know Medford to discuss the organization's mission of local government accountability and community storytelling. The founders shared their journalism backgrounds and addressed the challenges of reporting in a climate of reduced public transparency.

items.title: Introduction of Gotta Know Medford
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced the three founders of Gotta Know Medford and defined the program's goal of providing facts to inform citizens.

items.title: Journalism backgrounds
items.summary: Nell Escobar Coakley, Chris Stevens, and Wendall Waters detailed their combined decades of professional experience in local newspaper editorial and reporting roles.

items.title: Decline of local newspapers
items.summary: The founders attributed the disappearance of local news titles to corporate media priorities and the failure of regionalized reporting models.

items.title: Organizational mission and value
items.summary: The founders stated that the digital newspaper aims to hold local government accountable while fostering community connection through local stories.

items.title: Reporting scope and expansion
items.summary: The team plans to cover local sports, arts, schools, and government meetings, recently hiring a veteran sports reporter to bolster their coverage.

items.title: Editorial decision-making
items.summary: The founders described their collaborative approach to story selection and their commitment to editorial honesty within the team.

items.title: Success measurement and outreach
items.summary: The organization utilizes reader analytics for measurement and plans to host a news desert workshop at the Medford Public Library in the fall.

items.title: Challenges to government transparency
items.summary: The founders highlighted difficulties in obtaining public information from City Hall due to restrictive communications protocols and official reluctance to speak.

items.title: Community engagement and contact details
items.summary: The group invited residents to reach out via their website and email with story ideas or suggestions for the new publication.
